headline: Gold Prices Stabilize Near One-Year Lows as Federal Reserve Outlook Weighs
summary: Spot gold steadied around $3,580 per ounce after briefly falling below $3,500, as stronger-than-expected US inflation data reinforced expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate increases.
why: Gold is widely held as a non-yielding safe-haven asset and inflation hedge; its valuation reacts inversely to rising real interest rates and US dollar strength.

impacts.name: Spot Gold
impacts.why: Expectations of higher US interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Hot US inflation data fueled expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening, raising bond yields and the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding precious metals.
